tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs bzhugs so/// /

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ārya badzra bhai ra ba dha ra ni nā ma/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs zhes bya ba/ sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// rgyal ba sras dang bcas pa/ dri ma med pa/ dri ma sel ba/ mtha' yas pa/ mu thug pa med pa/ dam pa sbyin pa/ shin tu rgya che ba/ thams cad bdag la mthun par rtag tu mtha' yas pa'i dam pa'i mchog stsol bar gyur cig /de la nga'i rdo rje'i tshig ni 'di dag go /a ra ra/ a sa ma/ sa mantā nanta dharma tre kha ṇā kha ṇā/ ma hā bi re/ tsa le sa ma ma/ ā sa ha/ ma hā ba le/ ka ṇa ka ṇa/ ma hā ba la ga gri he/ ha ha badzra/ badzra hā ye/ dha ra dha ra/ hūṃ hūm̐ maṇḍa la sa ma ba ra akka bikka me/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ru tu rusarba thaṃ/ sarba hi/ dzwa la dzwa la/ akki ni/ phaṭa swā hā/ rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags thams cad kyi snying po 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan sngar lan stong zlas brjod byas na/ rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags thams cad lan 'bum bzlas brjod byas par 'gyur ro// las gzhan thams cad kyang don yod cing thogs pa med par byed de/ dam tshig gsum pa'i cho ga las 'byung ba'i rig sngags dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ gzungs thams cad kyi nang na las thams cad byed pa yin no// de nas cho ga mi bzad pa// rdo rjes gtams pa 'dra ba ni// klu dang lha min srin bcas pa'i// sum cu gsum lhas mi shigs pa// de khros pas ni lhas mchod pa'i// brgya byin nyid kyang 'dar bar 'gyur// 'byung po kun gyis ma smad pa// de ni srung bar byed pa'i mchog /ji ltar lhar bcas 'jig rten na// sangs rgyas 'dra ba'i ston pa med// bden pa'i tshig ni de yis ni// skye bo kun la srung gyur cig /tadya thā/ o badzra pra ka ra badzra pra ka ra/ badzra duṣṭaṃ bha yā pa hā/ tsu ru tsu ru/ pa ri tsu ma bi ke /tsu lu te le/ na mo ratna tra yā ya/ na mo badzra bhai ra ba syā/

ma hā ga ṇa pa ti syā badzra shasti/ pa rshu/ pā sha/ ha stā ya/ badzra ka na ka /badzra bai ḍūrya laṃ kṛ ta/ shi rā rā ya/ badzra pā ṇi ra nu pā lā ya/ tadya thā/ bhu ru bhu ru a na yā a na yā ma hā ga ṇā pa ti/ la ghu la ghu/ e hya hi/ ākk+ra ma/ ākk+ra ma/ sha ri raṃ/ gri hi tam gri hi tam/ dṛṣṭa mā/ dṛṣṭa mā bā/ att+ra bi sha tu sha rī raṃ/ kishtsi rā ya si/ bi dhu na/ ba dhu na/ pa ṭa pa ṭa/ kamba kamba/ raṅga raṅga/ mo rdha mo da/ dha ma dha ma/ badzrimbā badzrimbā/ pū ra pū ra/ ghurṇa ghurṇa/ a bi sha a bi sha/ shi ghraṃ shi ghraṃ/ ma hā badzra bhai ra bo/ ga ṇa pa ti rā dzñā pa ya ti swā hā// cho ga la dgra thams cad rengs par bya ba dang*/ byad stems thams cad bcad pa la ni ba'i lci ba la dkyil 'khor gru bzhi pa byas la/ sems khros pas mtshon cha la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ sa la btsugs na de ma thag tu byad stems thams cad 'chad par 'gyur ro// pha rol gyi dmag tshogs bzlog par 'dod pas ni dbyug pa la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ de phyogs su 'phangs na dgra thams cad myos par 'gyur ro// klu dbang du bya bar 'dod na khros te rdo rje la lan bdun bzlas brjod byas te/ bsnun na klu rnams dbang du 'gyur ro// ser ba bzlog par 'dod pas ni rdo rje ha cang mi drag par bskor zhing*/ sgra ha cang gsang mi mtho bar brjod na klu rnams ser ba mi 'bebs par 'gyur ro// chang bsrung bar 'dod pas ni chang gi rdzas rnams dang yungs kar la lan bdun bsngags na thub par 'gyur ro// nad zhi bar 'dod pa la ni nad dang mthun pa'i sman nam/ chu la lan bdun bsngags te 'thungs sam/ byugs na nad las grol bar 'gyur ro// las gang byed pa de thams cad la yang lan bdun bzlas brjod byas na bsam pa de 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'phags pa rdo rje 'jigs byed kyi gzungs zhes bya ba/ ma rungs pa phyir zlog pa rdzogs so//

༈ 'phags pas gsungs pa'i gzungs rnams rnam mang yang*// rdo rje 'jigs byed zhal nas gsungs pa'i gzungs// bsrung bya'i las bdun ldan pa'i gzungs mchog 'di// kun gyis mthun mong ma yin rnal 'byor dam pa'i gzungs// rnal 'byor gyi rnal 'byor chen po don yod rdo rje'i zhal snga nas bsgyur nas/ bod kyi ban dhe skye 'od 'byung la gnang ngo*/// /
